[b]Retaking of Revini[/b]

[i]May 10

"Colleagues, calm down, settle down, settle down.... Silencio! SILENCIO!" The consul said slamming his table which reverberated throughout the dim senate building. He cleared his throat and spoke, "We have retaken Ottominus and have begun marching west to where Revini lies. We have already sent funds and manpower to Ottominus to rebuild the city. Gentlemen, while we have been trying to maintain peace and tranquility, I believe it is right to strengthen and modernize the military!" He says as the senate interrupts, shouting in agreement before settling to allow him to speak. "Gentlemen, soon, Revini will return to Sanguivallis!" He patriotically declared, the senate devolving into unorganized yelling that more or less corelated with the Consul.

In Ottominus, the remaining Sanguinian forces marched to their home town for a stop over before heading west where Revini once lied, were greeted with a hero's welcome. A day later after the celebration, the military put together a combined force of 50,000 men, complete with trucks headed west, albeit with obsolete equipment. The forces led by Armani Giorgo, with a speech from the consul, set out west, towards Revini.

The long and uneventful journey there took 7 days, only eventful thing were soldiers needing to use the restroom and bandits being arrested along the way. When they finally got to Revini, they were met with abandoned buildings and overgrown ruins. "Is this truly Revini?" the soldiers scoffed to themselves, as they walked around it then began to sink in that it was indeed the historic city, as they encounter the old cathedral.

The cathedral in question had its windows shattered and the entire thing was overgrown. The only thing left untouched was the crucifix, which the sun emanated behind it.
An old, unwashed man suddenly emerged from one of the cathedrals rooms, "Ah gentlemen, you have returned" he said, as the men inside the cathedral turned and pointed their guns to him, "There is no need for that" he said gently. The soldiers shouted back, "What is your business here?" to the old man as he took a seat on a nearby bench. "I take it you men are here to retake Revini correct? I was a priest serving in this cathedral under the previous bishop back then, when the city defected it was doing rather well until an earthquake struck the city, the local government fled and left its people which led to the people either dying here or fleeing to other nations. Since then, the city has been slowly returning to where it belonged, I heard of the new consul and his approach in leading the country, it seems like he has some ambition sending you boys here." He said as he grasped his stick. "There are no opposition for you here, I am the sole resident of this city and I have made the cathedral my residence." He said before disappearing into one of the cathedral's rooms.

The dumbfounded men then returned to their higher-ups, reporting of what exactly happened, their superiors also confirming that the city was a ghost town. In the end, General Giorgo called for a clean up as with his second in command in charge as he travelled back to Ventusia.

"So Revini returned to the times and the Earth as it seems." the consul Abecci said as he took a sip from his mug sat beside the chief of the military, General Mario Cielinni. "I suppose I shall hold a hearing about this in the senate tomorrow."

In the end, the consul allocated some funds to both the cleanup and rebuilding of Ottominus and Revini, mostly focused on the latter. For now, the Sanguinian forces remained west in Revini preparing to reach the coast where Oceanium lied.[/i]
